title: A Orbit for the Static
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Felix Galloway, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
